closing_text:
I did not start a new native check attempt, because the only grant that covers the manual-member delivery has expired. I made no writes of any kind.

**What I checked** (clock read at 03:01:14Z and again at 03:01:29Z, UTC):

- **Grant:** the work record has one grant, `manual-readout` revision 1. It is still recorded as `active`, for actor `agent:claude-w4`, delivery `manual-member`, actions read/test/report only. But it expired at `2026-09-15T02:58:51Z`, about two minutes before now. No later revision or other grant exists. Under the contract, expiry stops any future action, so a new attempt has no authority. Your message says it doesn't renew the grant, so I didn't use it that way.
- **Latest attempt:** run `9cd6d05d-5141-44b8-ae3b-e6614ac31f2f` is `stopped`. Its receipt was reconciled at 02:22:09Z and it has no successors. The earlier attempt is therefore not what blocks a new one; the expired grant is. Its claim record also expired at 02:58:51Z.
- **Native ownership:** `repos/manual-member/OWNER.md` still gives serial read/test/report ownership to `agent:claude-w4` until 07:39:21Z. HEAD is `226a6f2cec3d85c4c88f9bc5247c06dca068ad9e`, which matches the declared revision, and `git status` is clean. Ownership is recorded separately from authority, so it doesn't replace the missing grant.
- **Other delivery:** docflow-member is still at `6364b79câ€¦`, only the `main` branch exists, and the stopped `fixture-executor` claim is still blocking it. It is outside this grant anyway.
- **Records:** the workspace records (including the prior run) are uncommitted working-tree edits on top of `0ccdcdd`. I left them as they are. I wrote nothing to the work, run or INDEX records: the mandate names `qualification-controller` as the canonical planning actor, and a record of a declined attempt isn't needed.

## Status at a glance

- **This run:** I only read files and ran checks; nothing was written, started or delegated. The one verify gate was `node /opt/docflow-source/plugins/docflow/workspace/validate.mjs /workspace/w4 --at 2026-09-15T03:01:27Z`, which returned `"valid": true, "diagnostics": []` with exit code 0. The validator only checks that records are consistent; it doesn't grant permission. Next action decided: **no new manual-member attempt; blocked because grant `manual-readout` r1 expired at 02:58:51Z.**
- **Overall:** blocked. Work `74182956` stays `active`. The manual-member delivery is still recorded as complete from the earlier reconciliation. The `docflow-member-check` and `independent-reconciliation` criteria still have no evidence.
- **Yet to do:**
  - For another manual-member readout, `qualification-controller` would need to record new, compatible authority (a new grant revision or grant) before 07:39:21Z. After that the claim needs rechecking and a new run with its own identity.
  - The docflow-member delivery needs its own grant, and the stopped `fixture-executor` claim on `work/0001-example` needs resolving at the native source.
  - Once both checks exist, they need to be reconciled together.
  - The uncommitted workspace records still need `qualification-controller` to decide what to do with them.
